title: Production read of the agent policy for the runner: site API catalogue plus S3 body
description: Done in the PR for PPY-c8175e (#1638). SiteCatalogue (getSiteDocument, getSiteDocumentVersion by key) over the site's API and SiteStore over S3, current version only; runner role gains s3:GetObject on tenants/*/site/agents/* (statement SiteAgentPolicyBody). The write side (a production adapter for AgentPolicyStore changes, with papyrus agents set-rung) is still open under H3, PPY-e6f31e.
